title: Rational-circle rigidity for magic squares of squares: certified exclusions, a genus-five reduction, and surfaces of general type
release: Author-review draft with rigidity section, second referee pass applied, 13 October 2026
main_results: Exclusion of specified rational-circle two-parameter normal forms through exponent sum seven
Exact D1 existence equivalence with additional rational points on an explicit genus-five curve

Rational-circle rigidity conjecture; exhaustive four-parameter search at projective height <= 4 (0 and infinity included, free-angle families handled exactly) over all 11,862 squarefree full-depth configurations finds no admissible point
All 48 Hadamard four-parameter solution surfaces are of general type: degree-8 covers of a minimal surface with p_g=11, q=0, K^2=32
originality_assessment: Bounded primary-source comparison; no first-in-literature claim
proof_record_policy: All 251 verification files copied from the latest research package retain identical bytes; broader results stay in the extended record.
new_in_this_release: Section 8 (rigidity conjecture, Proposition 8.2, Theorem 8.3), verification/four_prime/, six new verifier stages; Conjecture 7.3 restated as the D1 instance of rigidity; title and abstract updated

paper_fixes: full-depth defined for general integer matrices so Theorem 1.1 is a genuine case of Conjecture 8.1
dichotomy restated as 'smallest failing r' (not an r=4 dichotomy)
Conjecture 7.3 equivalent to rigidity for D1, implies it for B2,C,E2
Proposition 8.2 restated at projective height 4 including 0 and infinity
Theorem 8.3(1) now states within-B_i intersections are transversal (needed for A_1 only)
abstract: stronger than nonexistence for primitive squares
code_fixes: r4search.py: grid is projective (0 and infinity included); the branch where both relations vanish identically (a free-angle family) was previously skipped silently — it occurs 12,240 times at height 4 and is now decided exactly (every family is degenerate)
verify_hadamard_types.py: contact-order test documented as conservative
referee_pass_8_october.legacy: the earlier finite-chart height-5 sweep (no 0/inf, free-angle branch untreated) is kept as results/r4_H5_affine_legacy.json and is not relied on

fixes: Theorem 8.3 proof: type II has 16 simple tangencies and NO transversal B1∩B2 points (intersection number 32 = 16·2); the earlier text said 16+16, which is impossible

Theorem 8.3(3): the angle change is a torus isogeny; the induced map of compactifications is a dominant generically finite RATIONAL map of degree 8, not a finite morphism; κ-monotonicity for rational maps used
all B1∩B2 counts re-derived against the intersection number for all four types
added: Conjecture 8.5 (weak form: non-density, the statement Bombieri–Lang actually supports)
Conjecture 8.6 (torsion-coset hypothesis) with its inductive reduction of rigidity in all dimensions to the three-parameter cases
